# MJPDF
> Free online PDF tools: convert Word/PowerPoint to PDF, compress, merge, split, protect, rotate, watermark, and more.

MJPDF (https://mjpdf.onrender.com/) is a browser-based PDF toolkit. Users upload a file, the server processes it, and the result is available to download. Files are not stored permanently.

## Main tools
- Word to PDF: https://mjpdf.onrender.com/word-to-pdf
- PowerPoint to PDF: https://mjpdf.onrender.com/pptx-to-pdf
- Compress PDF: https://mjpdf.onrender.com/compress-pdf
- Merge PDF: https://mjpdf.onrender.com/merge-pdf
- Split PDF: https://mjpdf.onrender.com/split-pdf
- Extract Pages: https://mjpdf.onrender.com/extract-pages
- Delete Pages: https://mjpdf.onrender.com/delete-pages
- Images to PDF: https://mjpdf.onrender.com/images-to-pdf
- PDF to Images: https://mjpdf.onrender.com/pdf-to-images
- Rotate PDF: https://mjpdf.onrender.com/rotate-pdf
- Organize PDF: https://mjpdf.onrender.com/organize-pdf
- Watermark PDF: https://mjpdf.onrender.com/watermark-pdf
- Protect PDF: https://mjpdf.onrender.com/protect-pdf
- Unlock PDF: https://mjpdf.onrender.com/unlock-pdf
